description:
The District of Summerland has international agreements with three cities across the globe. Our sister city is located in Toyokoro, Japan 
and our two friendship cities are Kahama, Tanzania and Santa Cruz del Norte, Cuba. 
For more information, please visit: https://www.summerland.ca/your-city-hall/sister-city/international-agreements?pname=International%20Agreements

The District's description above references a document whose link on summerland.ca no longer resolves, so the reference is given as plain text rather than a broken link.
